settings.showSpeedOnStage: Show playback speed on stage screen
settings.showSpeedOnStageDesc: Displays the playback speed badge (e.g. 1.00x, 1.25x) on the stage monitor for the singer.
settings.autoArchiveWarningDesc: Warning: by disabling automatic archiving, downloaded songs will not be saved to the permanent library. They will remain available in the temporary cache only while they are in the queue (even when restarting the app) and will be deleted from disk only when they are dequeued or the queue is cleared.
settings.stageMessagesDesc: Customize text, formatting, size, and visibility for Stage banners (Now Singing, Get Ready, Up Next, …). Empty text keeps the current language default. Use {{name}} for the singer name where applicable.
settings.stageMessageTextPlaceholder: Leave empty to use language default
settings.stageMessageBackground: Stage background while this message is shown
settings.stageMessageBackgroundHint: Optional. Overrides the Stage theme/video backdrop only while this message is visible; the normal Stage look returns when it hides.
settings.vocalRemoverAlgorithmDesc: Used only by the Control Rimozione Vocale button (`V`). Classical mid/side DSP — no AI / no model download.
settings.maxSimultaneousDownloadsDesc: Shared limit for traditional Download and Download Instrumental. Extra jobs wait in the Download menu queue.
settings.instrumentalVocalRemoverDesc: Used only by YouTube Download Instrumental. Choose offline AI (UVR-MDX Karaoke 2 or HTDemucs; models download once into userData/models). Never applied to live Rimozione Vocale.
settings.instrumentalSubtitlesPolicyDesc: Same preference as “Remember my choice” on the Download Instrumental confirm dialog. Ask every time, always burn YouTube auto-subs, or never. Changing here updates or clears the remembered choice.
settings.mdxAdvancedDesc: Shown only for UVR-MDX-NET Karaoke 2. Adjusts chunk geometry and ORT CPU acceleration for Download Instrumental ETA / quality trade-offs.
settings.mdxSegmentSizeTooltip: Chunk size processed by the model (UVR dim_t). Smaller values use less RAM/CPU and often finish sooner, but may reduce continuity/quality; larger values improve stability at the cost of memory and time. Karaoke 2 default is 256.
settings.mdxOverlapTooltip: Fractional overlap between successive MDX windows. Higher overlap usually improves quality but increases ORT runs and ETA. Maps to hop = (1 − overlap) × chunk_size.
settings.mdxOverlapHighWarning: High overlap (≥ 0.75): separation will be much slower (many more ORT windows). Prefer 0.25–0.50 unless you need studio-grade continuity.
settings.mdxEnableOrtDesc: When on: ORT WASM graph optimizations + SIMD. When off: graph opts disabled and SIMD off. ORT is still required for MDX — this does not skip the engine.
settings.autoMaximizeControlDesc: Opens the Regia (Control) window maximized at startup. Uses maximize(), not exclusive fullscreen.
settings.autoOpenStageDesc: When off, Stage stays closed until you reopen it with P / F2 or the Stage button.
settings.aiCpuThreadsDesc: Thread count for MDX / Demucs during Download Instrumental. Default uses all detected cores.
settings.dspEngineDesc: Default is Bungee (Wasm AudioWorklet). SoundTouch remains available as a lighter legacy option. MIDI/KAR always uses SpessaSynth note transpose — not this DSP.
settings.dspEngineCompareBody: Compare architecture, quality range, latency, and CPU. Bypass is bit-perfect when pitch is 0 and speed is 1.00x.
settings.dspEngineBungeeBlurb: Phase vocoder Wasm AudioWorklet. Recommended ±8 ST (up to ±12). Independent pitch and speed (0.50x–1.50x). ~40 ms algorithmic latency when active; higher CPU than SoundTouch.
settings.dspEngineSoundTouchBlurb: WSOLA ScriptProcessor. Hard ±4 ST. Speed via media element. Near-zero CPU at pitch 0 (processor disconnected). Lighter on older machines.
settings.dspEngineMidiNote: MIDI/KAR pitch and tempo never pass through Bungee or SoundTouch.
settings.demucsAdvancedDesc: Shown only for HTDemucs. Adjusts shift averaging, segment length, and window overlap for Download Instrumental quality / ETA trade-offs.
settings.demucsShiftsDesc: Extra shifted passes averaged for cleaner stems (0 = single pass; 1–2 = slower, usually better).
settings.demucsSegmentSizeDesc: Preferred chunk length (5–20 s). The embedded ONNX window is fixed (~7.8 s); settings are applied to overlap/shift policy.
settings.demucsOverlapDesc: Fractional overlap between successive Demucs windows (0.10–0.50). Higher overlap improves continuity but increases ETA.
settings.aiEnableGpuDesc: When on, Instrumental AI prefers WebGPU via a hidden Chromium renderer when a GPU adapter is available. If GPU is off or unavailable, separation uses WASM CPU with the thread count below. The badge is green only when WebGPU is really active.
settings.aiGpuBadgeHardwareOnly: Hardware GPU detected: {{name}} — AI still uses WASM (no WebGPU adapter)

firewall.title: Firewall & LAN Connection Assistant
firewall.winNotice: On first launch, if Windows Defender Firewall prompts you, choose "Private Networks" and click "Allow access". If mobile phones cannot load the page, unblock the TCP port with this command:
firewall.winGui: Control Panel ➔ Windows Defender Firewall ➔ Allow an app through firewall ➔ check "Karaoke Live Station" on Private Networks.
firewall.macNotice: On first launch, macOS will display a security prompt: click "Allow" to accept incoming connections. If blocked, authorize the app in macOS Firewall:
firewall.macGui: System Settings ➔ Network ➔ Firewall ➔ Options ➔ ensure "Karaoke Live Station" is set to "Allow incoming connections".
firewall.linuxNotice: If you use UFW or Firewalld on Linux, allow incoming TCP traffic for the Guest Portal ports so smartphones can connect:
firewall.apIsolationTip: Wi-Fi Tip: If smartphones cannot load the page despite being connected to the same network, verify in your router settings that "AP Client Isolation" is DISABLED.
